content: Supabase Storage has bucket-level fileSizeLimit and allowedMimeTypes. Default global limit ~50MB per file. Free tier bandwidth ~2GB/month. RLS policies required for upload access control - misconfigured RLS silently blocks uploads. No CDN caching by default - need manual headers. Public buckets expose direct URLs - use signed URLs for sensitive content. multipart/resumable uploads needed for files >6MB.
